description: Jenny provides flavor and a useful detail.

nodes.speaker: jenny
nodes.text: If you are browsing, do it fast. The night crowd steals with eye contact first.

options.text: Anybody buying nerves in a pack tonight?

nodes.speaker: jenny
nodes.text: BodyGuard still sends runners for cigarettes from the Italian place. Big appetite, tiny patience.

nodes.speaker: jenny
nodes.text: Saw her pass the block like she was counting shadows. Did not stay long enough to buy anything.
